newsitem.title: USA: Meta Group buys stake in Britain's Spikes Cavell.
newsitem.headline: Meta Group buys stake in Britain's Spikes Cavell.

text.p: META Group Inc said Friday it had made an equity investment in Spikes Cavell & Co Ltd, a market research company based in Newbury, Berkshire, in the United Kingdom.
META Group said it had invested about $2.3 million in Spikes Cavell for a 14.7-percent minority interest.
Spikes Cavell tracks the British and European information technology and telecommunications markets, supplying market intelligence to technology vendors.
Based in Stamford, Conn, META Group provides research, analysis, and consulting about developments and trends in information technology.
